name: Help Scout
one_liner: Help Scout is a customer support platform offering APIs for managing helpdesk mailboxes, support docs, and user authentication.
access_note: Developers can self-serve OAuth2 apps and API keys from their user profile. Some features like Restricted Docs require Plus or Pro plans.

evidence.quote: This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization, implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows.
Create one by navigating to Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App.
All API requests are made to https://docsapi.helpscout.net/ and all requests are served over HTTPS. The current version is v1.
